autoCompaction.exactPiModelBudgetNote: Two rules, applied by the registered context window of each model. (1) A model with this window keeps an exact compact point instead of a percentage: the device writes settings.compaction.modelOverrides[<provider>/<modelId>].reserveTokens = contextWindow - compactAtTokens = 700000, so Pi compacts exactly when cached context passes 300000 tokens. Pi checks contextTokens > contextWindow - reserveTokens before a prompt, between tool batches, and during overflow recovery, so one per-model number covers all three. (2) Every other model keeps the original 78% threshold through pi-auto-compact (preflight before a prompt) plus its alignment of the same 78% into Pi's per-model reserve (mid-run). Keeping the exact budget out of pi-auto-compact's alignedReserveTokens record matters: an unmanaged per-model reserve is treated as user-owned and left alone, while the same entry in the record would be overwritten with the 78%-derived 220000. The 1M window is magpie's own advertisement for the smart-split group and the DeepSeek models (GET /v1/models reports context_length/context_window 1000000, max_output_tokens 393216; codex members report 272000 and workbuddy/hy3 192000). magpie's routing log still shows the smart-split group's DeepSeek-first member degrading above about 300000 tokens (median 4.2 s at 150000-300000 cached, 17 s median / 44 s average above 300000, 69-120 s at about 500000), which is why the larger windows keep this exact cap rather than their full capacity; a global percentage cannot express it, because 30% of 1M is 300000 but 30% of 272000 would compact those models at 81600 tokens.
autoCompaction.summaryModelNote: The summarizer extension follows ctx.model instead of pinning a model, so the magpie routing group decides the backend: its compacting rule sends a compaction request to the Go-first DeepSeek group and passes over a member that cannot take a request as long as the whole conversation.

independentRuntimeExtensions.role: Summarizes a compaction with the session's active model, sending Pi's native summarization system prompt and keeping the 8192-token summary cap; returns without a summary when the model is missing, the request fails, or the summary is empty, so Pi's own compaction takes over
independentRuntimeExtensions.roleNote: Keeps its historical file name; it no longer pins a provider or model, so no device-local model id is declared here. This file is the only copy of the implementation, so the repository versions it; it stays outside the public export allowlist

independentRuntimeExtensions.role: Normalizes Pi lifecycle events and writes them to the moshi-hook daemon socket (named pipe on Windows); a missing daemon fails silently and never interrupts a turn
